description: Source code for the 'InviteProvider' class handling slash command '/invite' in Mattermost, including command registration, message parsing, permission checks, and user/channel management.

classes.name: InviteProvider
classes.description: Provides methods for handling the '/invite' slash command, including command execution, message parsing, permission validation, and user/channel management.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Returns the command object with trigger, description, and display name.

methods.description: Executes the invite command and returns a command response.

methods.name: doCommand

methods.description: Retrieves user(s) or group by username or group name.

methods.description: Parses the message to extract target users and channels.

methods.description: Validates if the user has permission to invite to each target channel.
